entities.name: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Landmark document adopted by the UN General Assembly on December 10, 1948, proclaiming the inalienable rights of all human beings. Drafted by a committee including Eleanor Roosevelt, René Cassin, and Charles Malik, it became the foundation of modern human rights law.
